what: owner review of a92a856: instrumentation open questions closed; S1a engineering path; state correction

decisions.metrology_lab: ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory with the relevant measurement explicitly inside its accredited scope (in India normally an appropriate NABL-accredited scope). Witness mass: SI-traceable microbalance calibration with OIML E2 or better certified reference masses where appropriate (OIML R111 certificates and traceability). Profilometry: calibration/verification with traceable surface standards consistent with ISO 25178-700. Quantitative SEM/EDS: documented quantitative method consistent with ASTM E1508. XPS energy-scale calibration per ISO 15472 or equivalent traceable procedure. No commercial lab is named yet: W4 issues the measurement specification first, then a lab satisfying it is procured.
decisions.cathode_temperature: Both where mechanically possible: a cathode-tube thermocouple is mandatory (robust, continuous); add an emitter pyrometer if there is a defensible line of sight and emissivity treatment. The tube thermocouple is never labelled emitter temperature; if pyrometry is impossible, emitter temperature is reported as unmeasured.
decisions.near_cathode_rga: Quantitative for the AO/lifetime programme (at least O2/N2/H2O partial pressures or calibrated response). For S1a engineering checkout an uncalibrated RGA may be used qualitatively, but such data cannot support an exposure-dose or lifetime claim. Before score-bearing or life use, calibrate the relevant species or establish traceable sensitivity factors.
decisions.ins_p12_coverage_factor: Planning coverage factor k = 2 for the witness-holder non-interference demonstration (the ~95 % expanded-uncertainty convention, not a substitute for the measured uncertainty model); with low effective degrees of freedom use the evaluated coverage factor and document it.
decisions.instrumentation_version: Keep v1-r2 (additive changes). v2 is reserved for a breaking schema change, changed measurement semantics, changed acceptance rules or incompatible id meaning.
